new_task_1.title: Reject misaligned DataArray groupers in groupby APIs
new_task_1.description: The upgrade tightens validation for `groupby` and `groupby_bins` when the grouping key is supplied as an xarray `DataArray`. Instead of accepting any grouper with a matching length and then grouping positionally, xarray now requires the grouper to align exactly with the object's coordinates and dimensions, preventing silent mis-grouping when labels or ordering do not match.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that grouping by an external `DataArray` only succeeds when that grouper is exactly aligned to the target object, so coordinate-misaligned inputs fail clearly instead of producing grouped results based only on positional length.

expectation.grounded: When `DataArray.groupby(...)`, `Dataset.groupby(...)`, `DataArray.groupby_bins(...)`, or `Dataset.groupby_bins(...)` receive a grouping key as an xarray `DataArray`, xarray should validate it with exact alignment against the grouped object before proceeding. If the grouper's coordinates or dimension labels do not align exactly with the target object, the operation must raise `ValueError` with the existing length-mismatch style error instead of grouping positionally. If the grouper is exactly aligned, grouping should continue with the same observable semantics as before.
expectation.conceptual: Users should be able to trust that a labeled xarray grouper is matched by labels, not merely by shape. A mislabeled or reordered grouping array should be rejected rather than silently grouping the wrong observations.

constraints.grounded: This validation applies specifically to groupers passed as `DataArray` objects. Existing support for hashable variable names, dimension-based grouping, one-dimensional `IndexVariable` groupers, multidimensional `DataArray` groupers that otherwise align exactly, and empty-group rejection must remain intact. Successful aligned grouping must keep current grouping results unchanged apart from the new pre-validation.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should prevent silent data corruption without changing the normal behavior of valid grouped workflows. It should preserve established groupby functionality for correctly aligned inputs while making invalid labeled inputs fail deterministically.

behavior: Grouping by a `DataArray` now requires exact coordinate and dimension alignment with the target object.
A `DataArray` grouper that has the same overall length but mismatched labels or ordering is rejected with `ValueError` instead of being applied positionally.
Exactly aligned `DataArray` groupers continue to produce the same grouped results as before.
The same exact-alignment rule applies to both plain `groupby` and `groupby_bins` entry points.
acceptance_criteria: When a user groups a `DataArray` or `Dataset` with an external `DataArray` grouper whose coordinates and dimensions exactly match the target object, the grouping should succeed and return the expected grouped result.
When a user supplies a `DataArray` grouper that has matching length but different coordinate labels or ordering, `groupby(...)` should raise `ValueError` instead of producing grouped output.
When a user supplies the same kind of misaligned `DataArray` grouper to `groupby_bins(...)`, the operation should likewise raise `ValueError` instead of binning positionally.
When grouping is requested by variable name or dimension name rather than an external `DataArray`, existing grouping behavior should remain unchanged.
